title: An evacuated role job that had reported is re-asked, its answer discarded
body:
Role jobs have no recorded verdict at their collect: the decision record is written only after collectRole returns, so an evacuation's Cancel of a role worker that had reported but was still running past the grace leaves a durable cancellation over an answer nobody recorded. The resume collects the job as cancelled — classify puts the cancellation ahead of the report — refuses it as missing-result, and re-asks, paying again for an answer the worker already wrote and that survives archived beside its attempt record. The implement path now records its verdict before the release; the role-job path has nothing equivalent to read back.
evidence: internal/reconcile/rolejob.go (collectRole's VerdictMissingResult refusal); internal/exec/subprocess/collect.go:278 (classify's cancelled-first case)
